interval_method: 95% Wilson observed-rate interval; descriptive bin support, not a calibration guarantee
findings: CatBoost has lower holdout log loss and Brier score and a smaller weighted absolute bin gap in these predeclared bins; this does not establish calibration in future campaigns.
Logistic bin [0.4,0.5): 1602 observations, mean predicted 0.42867 versus observed 0.37578, suggesting overprediction in this segment.
Logistic bins above 0.5 have 53 and 1 observations; CatBoost [0.6,0.8) has 21. Sparse tails are not reliable evidence of calibration.
Similar mean prediction and overall validation prevalence alone does not imply good calibration. Brier and log loss jointly reflect probability estimation and discrimination.
Neither model was recalibrated. Empty bins are omitted; sparse bins are marked separately and not joined to reliability lines.
